No blur, painterly strokes, photorealism, perspective convergence or isometric diamond. Small decorations may be ON furniture or walls; flat rugs underfoot do not block paths. REMOVE ALL guide labels and flat color blocks, no writing, UI, watermark. Room walls must not hide doorway gaps. Do not introduce closed doors. Dark brown leather sofa, flat red/charcoal stripe rug, minimal ornament, no weapons, no palace, no family photos.. All BED blocks are SINGLE beds.  STRICT BED COUNT: ONE single bed.
